title: Fix Gumball Drag Cursor Scale
description: 3D gumball: when dragging, objects fly out — the drag scale is too high and does not match the cursor. Fix screen-to-world translation so the selection follows the pointer 1:1.
summary: Real fly-away cause was absolute host deltas stacked on accumulate-style plugins (CAD AmendLast, lowpoly scratch, puzzle without session). Host now sends incremental last→pending deltas; puzzle scratch accumulates increments; ortho duck-typing kept. Puzzle gumball_transform_session test passed. DEBUG logs left for runtime confirmation.
